item.title: US Conservative Think Tank Proposes "South Korea and US Should Cooperate to Counter China's Malign Influence" (美보수 싱크탱크 “한미, 中의 악의적 영향력 맞서 협력해야” 제안)
item.description:
US Conservative Think Tank Proposes "South Korea and US Should Cooperate to Counter China's Malign Influence" (美보수 싱크탱크 “한미, 中의 악의적 영향력 맞서 협력해야” 제안)

Derek Morgan, Senior Vice President of the Heritage Foundation, a conservative think tank in Washington, DC, and researcher Anthony Kim, in a recently published report, stated that "despite internal and external pressures, the South Korea-US alliance remains strong and resilient," proposing that the two countries cooperate to counter China's "malign influence." According to a report attached to the Fiscal Year 2027 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) released by the Senate last month, it explicitly requires an investigation into the "malign influence of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP)" that has penetrated South Korea's infrastructure and society at large, to be submitted to Congress. Although there are still several steps before the bill is finally passed, it reflects the awareness of the issue across the US political spectrum. (미국 워싱턴 DC의 보수 성향 싱크탱크인 헤리티지재단의 데릭 모건 수석부회장·앤서니 김 연구원은 최근 발간한 보고서에서 “내·외부 압력에도 불구하고 한미 동맹은 여전히 강력하고 탄력적”이라며 한미가 중국의 ‘악의적 영향력(malign influence)’에 대응하기 위해 협력할 것을 제안했다. 상원이 지난달 공개한 2027 회계연도 국방수권법안(NDAA) 부속 보고서를 보면 처음으로 한국 인프라와 사회 전반에 침투한 ‘중국 공산당(CCP)의 악의적 영향력’을 조사해 의회에 제출할 것을 명시하고 있다. 법안이 최종 통과되기까지 여러 절차가 남았지만, 미 조야(朝野)의 문제의식을 반영하고 있는 것이다.)

The report acknowledges that "in an era when all US relationships are being examined through the lens of 'America First,' it is natural for even long-standing alliances to be uneasy," but also notes that "South Korea and the US have a foundation rooted in shared values, national security goals, and cutting-edge business cooperation," adding that "they can do much more together beyond security cooperation." It continues, "Now is the time for President Donald Trump, who has cultivated a spirit of practical partnership, and President Lee Jae-myung to confront emerging issues head-on, address geopolitical challenges, and invest in mutually beneficial economic development projects to further solidify the alliance," stating that "these joint actions will lead the time-tested alliance toward a future of greater freedom, opportunity, and prosperity." (보고서는 “미국의 모든 관계가 ‘미국 우선주의’라는 렌즈를 통해 검토되고 있는 시대에 오랜 동맹조차 불안해하는 것은 당연한 일”이라면서도 “한미가 공유된 가치, 국가 안보에 대한 목표, 최첨단 비즈니스 협력 등에 뿌리를 둔 기반을 갖추고 있다”며 “안보 협력을 훨씬 뛰어넘는 분야에서 함께 더 많은 일을 할 수 있다”고 했다. 이어 “실용적인 파트너십 정신을 키워온 도널드 트럼프 대통령과 이재명 대통령이 새로운 현안에 정면으로 맞서고, 지정학적인 과제를 해결하며, 상호 이익이 되는 경제 발전 프로젝트에 투자해 동맹을 한층 더 공고히 할 때”라며 “이런 공동 조치가 오랜 시간 검증된 동맹을 더 큰 자유, 기회, 번영의 미래로 이끌 것”이라고 했다.)

The report identifies shipbuilding and defense, energy production, and nuclear power including small modular reactors (SMRs) as areas where South Korea and the US can deepen cooperation to strengthen their foundation as a military-strategic alliance and elevate it to the next level. However, it also notes that "the economic system remains constrained by regulatory barriers that limit entrepreneurial opportunities," indicating that it is "time to address the more difficult issues that prevent South Korea from truly transforming into a dynamic economy." This reflects the concern among US political circles that the South Korean government is discriminating against American companies operating in the country. Michelle Steel, the incoming US ambassador to South Korea, also expressed this concern during her confirmation hearing last May, stating that "American companies doing business in South Korea deserve the same market access that South Korean companies enjoy in the United States." Notably, the "Coupang incident" stemming from a personal information leak last year has been a bilateral obstacle for over six months. (보고서는 한미가 군사·전략 동맹으로서 기반을 다지고, 동맹을 새로운 차원으로 한 단계 더 발전시키기 위해 협력을 심화할 수 있는 분야로 조선과 방산, 에너지 생산, 소형모듈원자로(SMR)를 비롯한 원자력 발전 등을 꼽았다. 그러면서도 “경제 시스템이 여전히 기업가적 기회를 제한하는 규제 장벽에 얽매여 있다”며 “한국이 진정으로 역동적인 경제로 거듭나는 것을 가로막는 더 어려운 문제들을 해결할 때”라고 했다. 이는 우리 정부가 국내에서 사업을 영위하는 미국 기업을 상대로 ‘차별’을 하고 있다는 미 조야의 문제의식이 투영된 대목이다. 부임이 임박한 미셸 스틸 주한 미국 대사도 지난 5월 청문회에서 “한국에서 사업을 영위하는 미국 기업들은 한국 기업들이 미국에서 누리는 것과 동일한 시장 접근권을 누릴 자격이 있다”며 문제의식을 드러냈다. 특히 지난해 개인 정보 유출 사태로 불거진 ‘쿠팡 사태’는 반년 넘게 양자(兩者) 관계의 장애물로 작용하고 있다.)

item.title: At a Policy Debate, "Return of Wartime Operational Control Could Accelerate US Departure from the Korean Peninsula" (野토론회서 “전작권 환수, 美 한반도 이탈 가속화할 것”)
item.description:
At a Policy Debate, "Return of Wartime Operational Control Could Accelerate US Departure from the Korean Peninsula" (野토론회서 “전작권 환수, 美 한반도 이탈 가속화할 것”)

Concerns have been raised that the push by the Lee Jae-myung administration to regain wartime operational control (OPCON), potentially as early as 2027, could accelerate the withdrawal of US forces from the Korean Peninsula. (이재명 정부가 이르면 2027년을 목표로 추진하고 있는 전시작전통제권 환수가 미군의 한반도 이탈을 가속화할 수 있다는 지적이 나왔다.)

People Power Party lawmaker Kang Sun-young and the North Korea Nuclear Response Research Group of the Foundation for the Advancement of the Korean Peninsula held a forum on the morning of the 22nd at the second sub-committee room of the National Assembly Members' Office Building, titled "Is the Return of Wartime OPCON Equaling the Dissolution of the Current ROK-US Combined Forces Command a Matter to Be Rushed?" (강선영 국민의힘 의원과 한반도선진화재단 북핵대응연구회는 22일 오전 국회의원회관 제2소회의실에서 ‘전작권 환수=현(現) 한미연합사 해체, 서두를 일인가?’라는 포럼을 개최했다.)

Tae-Hwa Hong, an Asia Fellow at the Foreign Policy Research Institute (FPRI) in the US, who presented that day, stated, "If South Korea rushes to take back wartime OPCON and formally blocks strategic flexibility, both pillars of deterring North Korea and checking China could weaken, potentially opening the door to a reduction or withdrawal of US Forces Korea." Fellow Hong elaborated, "From the US perspective, the reason for the existence of US Forces Korea is to deter North Korea and check China. If South Korea hastily takes back OPCON, the justification for (US Forces Korea's) deterrence of North Korea becomes blurred. If the South Korean government also explicitly denies US strategic flexibility, the function of US Forces Korea in checking China is also blocked." This suggests that at a time when the US is shifting its center of gravity toward containing China and seeking to step back from the Korean Peninsula, the return of wartime OPCON could accelerate the trend of US departure from the peninsula. Fellow Hong added, "The integrated combined command (through the ROK-US Combined Forces Command) was the bond that, to some extent, kept the US tied to the Korean Peninsula. A hasty return could be us breaking that bond with our own hands." (이날 발제자로 나선 홍태화 미국 외교정책연구소(FPRI) 아시아 펠로는 “한국이 전작권을 서둘러 가져가고 전략적 유연성을 공식적으로 차단하면, 북한 억제·중국 견제 두 축 모두가 약해지면서 주한미군 감축·철수의 길목이 열릴 수 있다”고 했다. 홍 펠로는 “미국 관점에서 주한미군의 존재 이유는 북한 억제와 대중국 견제”라며 “한국이 전작권을 서둘러 가져오면 (주한미군의) 북한 억제라는 명분이 흐려지고, 한국 정부가 미국의 전략적 유연성마저 명시적으로 거부하면 주한미군의 대중국 견제 기능 또한 막힌다”고 했다. 미국이 중국 견제로 무게중심을 옮기고 한반도에서 발을 빼려는 상황에서 전작권 환수가 미국의 한반도 이탈 흐름을 가속화할 수 있다는 것이다. 홍 펠로는 “(한미연합사를 통한) 통합된 연합 지휘는 미국을 그나마 한반도 묶어 두던 결속의 끈이었는데, 조급한 환수는 그 끈을 우리 손으로 끊어내는 일이 될 수 있다”고 했다.)

Hui-Rak Park, Chairman of the North Korea Nuclear Response Research Group of the Foundation for the Advancement of the Korean Peninsula, who presented on "Misunderstandings and Arrogance Surrounding the Return of Wartime OPCON," stated, "With the dual command and control design of a Korean commander-US deputy commander system and the Military Committee Meeting not yet sufficiently mature or verified, accelerating the timeline is a dangerous experiment." Chairman Park particularly diagnosed, "Some political circles and public opinion are mired in the image of 'self-reliant defense,' displaying a cognitive bias that minimizes and distorts complex security risks." (‘전작권 환수를 둘러싼 오해와 오만’ 발제를 맡은 박휘락 한반도선진화재단 북핵대응연구회 회장은 “한국군 사령관-미군 부사령관 체제와 군사협의위원회를 통한 이원적 지휘·통제 설계가 충분히 성숙·검증되지 않은 상태에서 시간표만 앞당기는 것은 위험한 실험”이라고 했다. 특히 박 회장은 “일부 정치권과 여론이 ‘자주국방’ 이미지에 매몰돼 복합 안보위험을 축소·왜곡하는 인지적 편향을 보이고 있다”고 진단했다.)

Jae-kyu Jang, a professor of military science at Yeungnam University, addressed the topic "The Alliance Politics Context of Returning Wartime OPCON and Challenges for Combined Defense," pointing out that changes to the wartime OPCON structure inevitably accompany adjustments to the role of US Forces Korea and a redesign of the ROK-US alliance. Professor Jang expressed concern, stating, "The dissolution or transformation of the ROK-US Combined Forces Command is not a simple organizational restructuring but a process of rewriting the alliance's 'political contract'—including the role and mission of US Forces Korea, the C4I (Command, Control, Communications, Computers, and Intelligence) system, transitioning DEFCON during crises, and the operation of joint delegated command authority. If a speed-focused approach is taken without sufficient strategic dialogue and domestic political consensus, it could create cracks in alliance trust and crisis management mechanisms." (장재규 영남대 군사학과 교수는 ‘전작권 환수의 동맹 정치 맥락과 연합방위의 과제’를 주제로 전작권 구조 변화가 주한미군 역할 조정과 한미동맹 재설계를 동반할 수밖에 없다는 점을 짚었다. 장 교수는 “한미연합사 해체 혹은 변형은 단순 조직 개편이 아니라, 주한미군 역할·임무, C4I(지휘·통제·통신·컴퓨터·정보) 체계, 위기 시 데프콘 전환과 공동위임지휘권 운용 등 동맹의 ‘정치적 계약’을 다시 쓰는 과정”이라며 “충분한 전략 대화와 국내 정치적 합의 없이 속도전을 벌일 경우 동맹 신뢰와 위기관리 메커니즘에 균열이 생길 수 있다”고 우려했다.)

In her opening remarks, lawmaker Kang Sun-young, who hosted the forum that day, said, "Discussions on wartime OPCON are matters that require not only the government, military, and alliance partners but also the National Assembly and the public to share sufficient information, debate, and deliberate on them." She added, "With North Korea, China, and Russia accelerating military modernization, and Kim Jong-un strengthening aggressive foreign strategies through troop dispatches to Russia's war, attending Victory Day events with Putin, and holding summit meetings with Xi Jinping, it cannot be said that conditions for the return of wartime OPCON have improved in any respect." (이날 토론회를 주최한 강선영 의원은 모두발언에서 “전작권 논의는 정부·군·동맹 파트너뿐 아니라 국회와 국민이 충분한 정보를 공유해 토론하고 숙고해야 할 사안”이라며 “북·중·러가 군사 현대화에 박차를 가하고 김정은이 러시아 전쟁 파병·푸틴과 전승절 행사 참석·시진핑과 정상회담 등으로 공격적인 대외 전략을 강화하는 상황에서, 어느 측면에서도 전작권 환수 조건이 호전됐다고 볼 수 없다”고 했다.)

item.title: Presidential Office: "President Lee Delayed Apartment Sale Balance Payment and Did Not Charge Interest" (靑 “李대통령, 아파트 매각 잔금 유예하며 이자 안 받아”)
item.description:
Presidential Office: "President Lee Delayed Apartment Sale Balance Payment and Did Not Charge Interest" (靑 “李대통령, 아파트 매각 잔금 유예하며 이자 안 받아”)

It has been confirmed that President Lee Jae-myung and his wife, during the process of selling their apartment in Yangji Village, Bundang-gu, Seongnam-si, Gyeonggi Province, for 2.9 billion won, transferred ownership to the buyer first, delayed the payment of a large balance for several months, and also provided an 'interest-free' benefit. The Presidential Office explained this as goodwill toward the buyer, but large interest-free transactions between private individuals could be subject to gift tax evasion. The Presidential Office stated, "If the buyer has to pay gift tax, they will bear it." <<> On the morning of the 22nd, the Presidential Office addressed suspicions regarding the sale of President Lee's home through its official YouTube channel's own program, 'Fact Mill.' The transaction was finalized at a total of 2.9 billion won, and President Lee's side transferred ownership to the buyer in advance on the condition of receiving the balance at the end of October. Instead, a collateral mortgage of 1.77 billion won was set up in case of non-payment of the balance. <<> Deputy spokesperson Ahn Gwi-ryeong, who hosted the program that day, explained the method of President Lee's apartment sale, saying, "Let's point out one more thing: typically, if the balance payment is deferred for several months, given the large amount, the interest alone would be substantial, but it has been confirmed that they agreed not to charge interest." Professor Han Moon-do from Yonsei University, who also appeared on the show, said, "It seems the President considered the buyer," adding, "Of course, one might ask why no interest is charged, but considering the gap is only 3-4 months, they decided not to charge interest." <<> The Presidential Office explained this as a positive story about the President and a gesture of goodwill toward the buyer, but it is problematic. This is because, when a large sum of money is transacted between private individuals or the balance is deferred without interest, tax issues may arise under the Inheritance Tax and Gift Tax Act. <<> Current tax law considers the interest difference as 'gifted' if money is borrowed from another person for free or at an interest rate lower than the appropriate rate. However, for loans between family members who are specially related individuals under tax law, gift tax is not imposed if the interest benefit from the interest-free loan is less than 10 million won annually. President Lee and his wife are not related to the buyer. <<> Earlier, in May, the National Tax Service announced plans for tax audits on suspected real estate tax evaders, listing 'cash-rich individuals not subject to loan regulations and individuals with excessive private debt' as the first type of audit targets. Examples included cases where individuals borrowed large sums from parents or others due to loan regulations making it difficult to get financial institution loans, or obtained funds from specially related individuals to purchase homes. They emphasized at the time that they would strictly verify whether the debt was actually borrowed and whether interest was paid. <<> In that day's broadcast, the reason for transferring ownership first and setting up a collateral mortgage was introduced. Yangji Village in Bundang, where the apartment is located, has been designated as a leading reconstruction zone for first-generation new towns. Professor Han said, "Reconstruction here is progressing through a trust company model. If a property is purchased after the date the local government designates and announces the trust company as the project implementer, the buyer cannot receive the 'membership rights' and becomes subject to cash settlement (so-called 'water ticket')." <<> Given that the designation announcement was expected around August, if the buyer paid the balance and took over ownership in October, they would lose the right to move into the new apartment. To remedy this, President Lee transferred the registration early. <<> Regarding suspicions of 'gap investment,' Professor Han said, "This area is a land transaction permit zone, so the buyer must undergo a local government's actual residency review. If they do not move in within six months after paying the balance, they must pay an enforcement fine (penalty) amounting to 10% of the apartment price annually, making gap investment fundamentally impossible." <<> The Presidential Office stated, "As a long-term resident of a single-home household, President Lee could have maintained his reconstruction membership status and achieved greater market profits without rushing to sell. Nevertheless, he sold his home and became a homeless person, demonstrating through leading by example the President's firm will to vigorously promote real estate policies going forward." <<> Regarding the gift tax issue, they said, "If the buyer has to pay gift tax, they will bear it." (이재명 대통령 부부가 경기 성남시 분당구 양지마을 아파트를 29억원에 매각하는 과정에서 매수자에게 소유권을 먼저 넘겨주고 거액의 잔금 지급을 수개월 유예해 주는 동시에 ‘무이자’ 혜택까지 제공한 것으로 확인됐다. 청와대는 매수자를 위한 선의라고 설명했지만, 사인 간의 거액 무이자 거래는 증여세 탈세 소지가 있다. 청와대는 “만약 매수자가 증여세를 내야 한다면 부담할 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: South Korea Detains Ship "Prada" Accused of Violating UN North Korea Sanctions (정부 “안보리 대북제재 위반한 선박 ‘프라다호’ 억류 중”)
item.description:
South Korea Detains Ship "Prada" Accused of Violating UN North Korea Sanctions (정부 “안보리 대북제재 위반한 선박 ‘프라다호’ 억류 중”)

The South Korean government has detained a ship that violated United Nations Security Council resolutions by transporting coal from a North Korean port. (북한 항구에서 선탄을 운반해 유엔 안전보장이사회의 대북 제재 결의를 위반한 선박을 한국 정부가 억류하고 있는 것으로 나타났다.)

According to diplomatic authorities on the 22nd, the government confirmed suspicions that the ship named PRADA, which entered Pyeongtaek Port in March, had violated North Korea sanctions. (22일 외교 당국에 따르면, 정부는 지난 3월 평택항으로 들어온 프라다(PRADA)호라는 선박의 대북 제재 위반 혐의를 확인했다.)

A foreign ministry official stated, "Based on information that the PRADA had been involved in activities violating past UN Security Council resolutions on North Korea, the government conducted a joint investigation by relevant agencies upon its entry into Pyeongtaek Port." (외교부 당국자는 “정부는 프라다호가 과거 안보리 대북 제재 결의 위반 활동에 관여했다는 정보를 바탕으로, 평택항에 입항한 동 선박에 대해 관계 부처 합동 조사를 진행했다”고 했다.)

He added, "The government investigation confirmed the PRADA’s involvement in violations of Security Council resolutions, and as a follow-up measure under the resolutions, the ship is currently being detained." The PRADA had been suspected of loading coal at a North Korean port, and authorities reportedly confirmed this to be true. (이어 “정부 조사 결과 프라다호의 안보리 결의 위반 가담 사실이 밝혀져 안보리 결의에 따른 후속 조치로서 동 선박을 억류 중”이라고 했다. 프라다호는 북한 항구에서 석탄을 선적했다는 의혹을 받았는데, 당국은 이것이 사실임을 확인한 것으로 알려졌다.)

Earlier, in May of last year, the private analysis agency Open Source Center (OSC) released satellite images showing the PRADA, operating under the name "Sophia," loading coal at North Korea's Nampo Port in September and December 2024. (앞서 작년 5월 민간 분석 기관 오픈소스센터(OSC)는 프라다호가 ‘소피아’라는 이름으로 운항하던 2024년 9월과 12월 북한 남포항에서 석탄을 선적하는 장면이 담긴 위성사진을 공개한 바 있다.)

The ship was also cited as having violated North Korea sanctions in a joint statement issued in May by South Korea, the United States, Japan, the European Union (EU), the United Kingdom, Australia, Canada, and New Zealand, urging the implementation of sanctions against North Korea. (이 선박은 지난 5월 한국·미국·일본과 유럽연합(EU)·영국·호주·캐나다·뉴질랜드 등이 발표한 대북 제재 이행 촉구 공동 성명에서 대북 제재를 위반한 것으로 언급되기도 했다.)

item.title: Cardinal Yu Heung-sik: "The Holy Father Can Do Great Things in Inter-Korean Relations" (유흥식 추기경 “교황님, 남북관계에 큰 일 하실 수 있어”)
item.description:
Cardinal Yu Heung-sik: "The Holy Father Can Do Great Things in Inter-Korean Relations" (유흥식 추기경 “교황님, 남북관계에 큰 일 하실 수 있어”)

Cardinal Yu Heung-sik (75), Prefect of the Dicastery for the Clergy, said on the 22nd, "It seems the Holy Father could do great things in inter-Korean relations," adding, "The Holy See is doing all it can (in its capacity)." (교황청 성직자부 장관 유흥식(75) 추기경은 22일 “교황님은 남북관계에 큰 일 하실수 있을 것 같다”며 “교황청으로서는 (할 수 있는) 모든 역할을 한다”고 했다.)

Cardinal Yu made these remarks in response to comments from Unification Minister Kim Young-ho during their meeting, where the minister expressed hope for the Holy See's role in creating a breakthrough in inter-Korean relations. (유 추기경은 이날 정동영 통일부 장관과 만난 자리에서 남북관계 돌파구 마련을 위한 교황청의 역할을 희망하는 정 장관 발언에 대해 이렇게 말했다.)

Minister Kim said that day, "I expect the Pope's visit to Korea next year will be a tremendous blessing for peace on the Korean Peninsula," and "The Korean Peninsula has been cut off from all contact, dialogue, and meetings with North Korea for the past seven or eight years. I hope the Pope's visit will serve as an opportunity to build that bridge." (정 장관은 이날 “내년에 교황님이 한국에 오시는 것이 한반도 평화의 아주 큰 축복이 될 것이라고 기대한다”며 “한반도는 지금 지난 7, 8년 동안 북한과의 일체 접촉, 대화, 만남이 끊어져 있는 상황인데 교황님께서 오심으로서 그 다리를 놓는 계기가 되길 기대한다”고 했다.)

In response, Cardinal Yu stated, "I proposed to Pope Francis several years ago that this World Youth Day be held in Korea," and "After months of preparation, we eventually succeeded in hosting this World Youth Day. So I, too, feel a sense of responsibility." He added, "Reflecting on the spirit of martyrdom and having young people gather in Korea to practice peace and harmony together would be immensely meaningful." (이에 유 추기경은 “몇 년 전 프란치스코 교황께 이번 세계청년대회를 한국에서 하자고 제안한 바 있다”며 “몇 달 동안 사전 준비를 거쳐 결국 이번 세계청년대회 유치가 이루어졌다. 그래서 저 역시 한편으로는 책임감을 느끼고 있다”고 했다. 그러면서 “순교 정신을 되새기고, 젊은이들이 함께 평화와 화합을 실천하며 한국에 모인다면 엄청난 의미가 있을 것”이라고 했다.)

Pope Leo XIV is scheduled to visit Korea to attend the '2027 Seoul World Youth Day (WYD)' in August next year. If Pope Leo XIV visits Korea, it will be his first visit to the country and the fourth papal visit in history. Seoul World Youth Day is the world's largest Catholic youth event organized by the Holy See, and it will be the second such event held in Asia. (레오 14세 교황은 내년 8월 열리는 ‘2027 서울 세계청년대회(WYD)’ 참석을 위해 한국을 방문할 예정이다. 레오 14세 교황 방한이 이뤄지면 그의 첫 방한이자, 역대 네 번째 교황의 방한이 된다. 서울 세계청년대회는 교황청이 주관하는 세계 최대 규모의 가톨릭 청년 행사로, 아시아에서 역대 두 번째로 열리는 대회다.)

Minister Kim said, "Apart from political implications, I hope that young people from the North can also participate when youth from around the world gather." He continued, "Before the Pope visits next year, we will work hard to restore trust between the two Koreas and help ensure the World Youth Day is a great success in a positive atmosphere." In response, Cardinal Yu stated, "The Pope's schedule and messages are immediately shared with all apostolic nunciatures worldwide, and the nuncios in each country can play a role by contacting the North Korean side according to local circumstances," adding, "He will be visiting from August 3rd to 8th next year, and we see such a role and are working towards it." (정 장관은 “정치적인 의미를 떠나서 세계 청소년들이 모이는데 북쪽의 청소년들도 함께 참석할 수 있기를 소망한다”고 했다. 이어 “내년에 교황님이 오시기 전까지 저희가 열심히 다시 남북 간의 신뢰 회복을 위해서 노력하고 좋은 분위기 속에서 세계 청년대회가 아주 성공적으로 되도록 잘 돕겠다”고 했다. 이에 유 추기경은 “교황의 일정과 메시지는 전 세계 교황청 대사관에 즉시 공유되고, 각국 교황대사들이 현지 상황에 맞게 북한 측과 접촉하는 등 역할을 할 수 있다”며 “(교황이) 내년 8월 3일부터 8일까지 방문하시는 데 그런 역할이 있다고 보고 노력하고 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: June 3 Local Elections: Voters Unable to Cast Ballots Rise from 44 to 91 (6·3 지방선거 투표 못한 유권자 44명→91명)
item.description:
June 3 Local Elections: Voters Unable to Cast Ballots Rise from 44 to 91 (6·3 지방선거 투표 못한 유권자 44명→91명)

On the 22nd, it was revealed that at least 91 voters were unable to cast their ballots during the main voting for the June 3 local elections due to a shortage of ballot papers. Earlier, the National Election Commission (NEC) had estimated, based on voting records, that 44 voters were unable to vote, but the figure more than doubled after reviewing closed-circuit television (CCTV) footage. <<> According to data submitted by the NEC to the office of People Power Party lawmaker Kim Eun-hye on the same day, the provisional count of voters who could not vote due to insufficient ballot papers in this local election stands at a minimum of 80 and a maximum of 91. The NEC calculated the provisional figure by combining voting records, CCTV footage, and statements from voting supervisors. <<> For example, at the second polling station in Munjeong 2-dong, Songpa-gu, Seoul, the voting record showed no entries for voters unable to vote, but CCTV review revealed that a total of 28 people were unable to cast their ballots. Similarly, at the 12th polling station in Pungmu-dong, Gimpo, Gyeonggi Province, while the voting record had no notable entries, CCTV analysis found that up to 5 voters were unable to vote. <<> The number of voters estimated to have been unable to vote due to ballot shortages is expected to rise further. The NEC has only conducted verification procedures for 22 of the 26 polling stations where voting was interrupted that had CCTV installed, and among these, images could only be identified from 11 locations. <<> Meanwhile, the National Assembly’s Special Committee on Parliamentary Investigation held its second hearing on the same day. The ruling and opposition parties clashed again, following the first hearing, over the timing of pursuing a public recount of ballots at the Jamsil Olympic Park polling station. <<> The Democratic Party of Korea argued that a recount should be conducted immediately before the special committee’s deadline of August 1, but some lawmakers from the People Power Party argued that the recount should be postponed until after the launch of a ‘special investigation into the NEC,’ even if it means extending the special committee’s term. <<> Yoon Geon-young, a Democratic Party lawmaker serving as the ruling party’s floor leader on the committee, stated, “The recount was initially proposed by Yoon Sang-hyun, the committee chair from the People Power Party, and the Democratic Party responded to address public suspicions. I cannot understand why, after making the proposal, the stance is now being reversed. We had an agreement between the parties, and if a special investigation is to be launched, why delay what the special committee can do?” <<> In contrast, People Power Party lawmaker Joo Jin-woo remarked, “A recount alone cannot resolve all the current suspicions. I believe it won’t be too late to conduct a recount after a special investigation objectively examines the matter.” <<> Yoon Sang-hyun, the chair of the special committee from the People Power Party, who initially called for a recount, stated, “A special investigation cannot replace a recount, nor can a recount replace a special investigation. If people in the square are calling for election fraud or a re-election, then let the public see the scene of the suspicions. It is our duty to clarify the truth through a recount.” (6·3 지방선거 본투표 당시 투표용지 부족으로 투표하지 못한 유권자가 최소 91명인 것으로 22일 나타났다. 앞서 중앙선관위원회는 투표록을 기준으로 44명이 투표하지 못한 것으로 추정된다고 했는데, 폐쇄회로(CC)TV 영상 확인 결과 추정치가 2배 이상으로 늘었다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Defense Ministry Pushes Ahead with Integrated Military Academy at Jaundae... Going Against Research Results ([단독] 자운대 통합 사관학교 강행... 국방부, 용역 결과와 반대로 갔다)
item.description:
[Exclusive] Defense Ministry Pushes Ahead with Integrated Military Academy at Jaundae... Going Against Research Results ([단독] 자운대 통합 사관학교 강행... 국방부, 용역 결과와 반대로 갔다)

According to a defense ministry research report on the integration of the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies, a majority of high school students willing to apply to military academies expressed a preference for Seoul or the greater capital area as the location. Furthermore, the preference for the previously proposed "2+2" academic system was higher than the "four-year integrated" system ultimately decided by the defense ministry. This has led to criticism that the defense ministry has pushed ahead with "Jaundae in Daejeon" and a "four-year integration" despite the research findings. (육·해·공군 사관학교 통합 추진 관련 국방부 용역 보고서에 따르면 사관학교 지원 의사가 있는 고교생 다수가 부지로 서울 등 수도권을 선호한다고 답한 것으로 나타났다. 학제 역시 기존에 나왔던 ‘2+2′안에 대한 선호도가 국방부가 최종 결정한 ‘4년 통합’보다 높게 나타났다. 국방부가 연구용역 결과와 달리 ‘대전 자운대’와 ‘4년 통합’을 강행했다는 지적이 나온다.)

According to a research report titled "Study on Plans for Integrating Military Academies" prepared by the Korea Institute for Defense Analyses (KIDA), an affiliated agency of the defense ministry, in April, 44.9% of high school students willing to apply to military academies cited Seoul and Gyeonggi Province as the "ideal location for an integrated campus." Only 12.9% of respondents chose Daejeon and South Chungcheong Province, 8.4% chose Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province, and a mere 4.5% chose Gwangju and North Jeolla Province. Students who were unwilling to apply or held a reserved stance also most frequently chose Seoul and Gyeonggi Province (32.9%~40.0%) as the ideal location. (국방부 산하 한국국방연구원(KIDA)이 지난 4월 작성한 ‘사관학교 통합 추진 방안 연구’ 용역 보고서에 따르면 사관학교에 지원할 의사가 있는 고교생 중 44.9%가 ‘통합 캠퍼스의 이상적 위치’로 서울·경기를 꼽았다. 대전·충남을 택한 응답자는 12.9%, 대구·경북 8.4%, 광주·전라는 4.5%에 불과했다. 사관학교 지원 의사가 없거나 유보적 입장인 학생들 역시 이상적 위치로 서울·경기(32.9%~40.0%)를 가장 많이 꼽았다.)

Notably, among the groups indifferent or reserved about attending a military academy, the highest increase in willingness to apply (31.7% and 40%, respectively) occurred when the main campus was located in the capital area. Regarding this, the research team stated, "This is two to three times higher than other regions," adding, "If prioritizing the discovery of potential applicants, the location of the integrated campus was overwhelmingly the capital area." The research team reportedly conducted this survey as part of examining changes in 500 high school students' willingness to apply based on variations in campus location. (특히 사관학교 진학 무관심 및 유보 집단에서는 본교가 수도권에 있을 때 가장 높은 지원 의사 상승(각각 31.7%, 40%)이 나타났다. 연구진은 이에 대해 “타 권역 대비 2~3배 수준”이라며 “잠재 지원자 발굴을 우선시 할 경우 통합 캠퍼스의 위치는 수도권이 압도적인 것으로 나타났다”고 했다. 연구진은 500명의 고교생을 대상으로 캠퍼스 위치 변화에 따른 지원 의향 변화를 살펴보는 과정에서 이 같은 설문 조사를 진행한 것으로 알려졌다.)

The research team suggested that if the integrated academy had to be located outside the capital area, "Based on minimizing attrition, the Chungcheong region should be considered, and based on maximizing influx, the Gyeongsangbuk-do and Yeongnam regions should take priority." However, the defense ministry ultimately selected Jaundae in Daejeon as the final location. (연구진은 통합사관학교를 비수도권에 둬야 할 경우 “이탈 최소화 기준으로는 충청권, 유입 극대화 기준으로는 경북과 영남권이 우선 검토 대상”이라고 했다. 하지만 국방부는 대전 자운대를 최종 입지로 선정했다.)

The defense ministry also pushed ahead with the launch of a four-year integrated military academy, rather than the "2+2" network-style academic system recommended by the civilian-military-government advisory committee. The "2+2" model involves Army, Navy, and Air Force cadets receiving common education together on one campus for their first and second years, then dispersing to separate campuses for specialized military training in their third and fourth years. (국방부는 민관군 자문위가 권고했던 네트워크 방식 ‘2+2’학제가 아닌 4년제 통합 사관학교 출범도 강행했다. ‘2+2’는 1~2학년은 한 캠퍼스에서 육·해·공군이 공통 교육을 받다가 3~4학년 과정은 각각 별도 캠퍼스로 흩어져서 군 전문성을 강화하는 형태다.)

According to the KIDA survey, the proportion in favor of the "2+2" integration was higher than the proportion in favor of the four-year integration ultimately decided by the defense ministry. In a survey of 1,000 ordinary citizens, 49.1% supported the four-year integration, while 71.4% supported the "2+2" integration plan. In a survey of 500 high school students, the proportion in favor of the "2+2" integration was 61.2%, higher than the 42.8% supporting the four-year integration. (KIDA 조사에 따르면 ‘2+2’ 통합에 찬성하는 비율이 국방부가 최종 결정한 4년제 통합에 찬성한 비율보다 높게 나타났다. 일반국민 1000명 조사에서 4년제 통합에는 49.1%가 찬성했지만 ‘2+2’ 통합안에는 71.4%가 찬성했다. 고등학생 500명 조사에서도 ‘2+2′ 통합에 찬성하는 비율이 61.2%로 4년제 통합(42.8%)보다 높았다.)

According to the research results, the integrated academy should have been established in the capital area using the "2+2" model, but the defense ministry announced its "basic plan" for a four-year integrated academy in the Chungcheong region on the 16th. (연구용역 결과대로라면 통합사관학교는 수도권에 2+2 형태로 만들어져야 했지만, 국방부는 충청권에 4년제 통합이라는 ‘기본계획’을 지난 16일 발표했다.)

A retired military official commented, "Even the KIDA research results, which are inevitably heavily influenced by the defense ministry, came out this way, yet the ministry refused to accept this and pushed ahead with the location and academic system selection for the military academy," adding, "It's hard to avoid criticism that the integration of the academies is being rushed through in a predetermined, slapdash manner." (예비역 군 관계자는 “국방부 영향을 절대적으로 받을 수밖에 없는 KIDA 연구결과에서도 이런 내용이 나왔는데 국방부는 이조차도 받아들이지 않고 사관학교 위치 선정 및 학제를 강행했다”며 “사관학교 통합을 ‘답정너’식으로 졸속 추진하고 있다는 비판을 피하기 어렵다”고 했다.)

item.title: Ruling Party Urges "Take Political Responsibility" After Oh Se-hoon's First Trial, while the Cho Kuk Party Calls for "Immediate Resignation" (오세훈 1심에 與 “정치적 책임 져라” 조국당 “즉각 사퇴하라”)
item.description:
Ruling Party Urges "Take Political Responsibility" After Oh Se-hoon's First Trial, while the Cho Kuk Party Calls for "Immediate Resignation" (오세훈 1심에 與 “정치적 책임 져라” 조국당 “즉각 사퇴하라”)

After Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon was sentenced to loss of office in the first trial on the 22nd over the "opinion poll cost proxy payment" allegations, the Democratic Party of Korea stated, "He should humbly admit his guilt and fulfill his legal and political responsibilities." The Cho Kuk Innovation Party demanded that Mayor Oh abandon his appeal and resign immediately. (오세훈 서울시장이 22일 ‘여론조사비 대납 의혹’으로 1심에서 시장직 상실형을 선고받자 더불어민주당은 “자신의 죄를 겸허히 인정하고 법적, 정치적 책임을 다하라”고 했다. 조국혁신당은 오 시장에게 항소를 포기하고 즉각 사퇴할 것을 요구했다.)

Democratic Party Senior Spokesperson Kang Joon-hyun said this in a written commentary on the same day, describing it as "a just result for an obvious crime of receiving opinion poll results from a political broker and having a donor pay the costs on his behalf." (민주당 강준현 수석대변인은 이날 서면 논평을 통해 “정치 브로커로부터 여론조사 결과를 제공받고 후원자에게 비용을 대납시킨 명백한 범죄에 대한 사필귀정의 결과”라며 이같이 말했다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang stated, "The court recognized that Mayor Oh received opinion poll results from political broker Myung Tae-kyun ahead of the 2021 Seoul mayoral by-election and had businessman Kim Han-jung pay the costs on his behalf," adding, "In particular, the court acknowledged the likelihood that Mayor Oh commissioned the opinion poll from Mr. Myung and specified that the 10 million won paid by donor Mr. Kim was also opinion poll costs." (강 수석대변인은 “재판부는 오 시장이 2021년 서울시장 보궐선거를 앞두고 정치 브로커 명태균씨로부터 여론조사 결과를 받아보고 사업가 김한정씨를 통해 비용을 대신 내게 한 혐의를 인정했다”며 “특히 오 시장이 명씨에게 여론조사를 의뢰했을 개연성을 인정했으며, 후원자 김씨가 낸 1000만원 역시 여론조사 비용이었다고 명시했다”고 했다.)

In response, Senior Spokesperson Kang assessed, "The fact that Mayor Oh used the opinion poll commissioned from the political broker in his election and had the costs covered by a donor has been proven in court," calling it "a clear violation of the Political Funds Act and an act that undermines the election system itself, which is the foundation of democracy." (이에 대해 강 수석대변인은 “오 시장이 정치 브로커에 의뢰한 여론조사를 선거에 활용했고, 그 비용을 후원자에게 대납시켰다는 사실이 법원에서 입증된 것”이라며 “명백한 정치자금법 위반이자, 민주주의 근간인 선거 제도 자체를 훼손한 것”이라고 평가했다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang added, "Until just before the sentencing, Mayor Oh claimed that the special counsel and the Democratic Party were forcing a false conviction, maintaining a shameless attitude without any remorse," but "before the court's stern verdict, there is no room for such pitiful excuses." (강 수석대변인은 “오 시장은 선고 직전까지도 특검과 민주당이 억지 유죄를 강요한다고 주장하며 반성은커녕 뻔뻔한 태도를 일관해 왔다”며 “그러나 사법부의 엄중한 판결 앞에 구차한 변명은 설 자리가 없다”고 했다.)

Cho Kuk Innovation Party Spokesperson Lim Myung-hee stated, "It was not Myung Tae-kyun's fraud scheme, but Mayor Oh's fraud scheme against the public." (조국혁신당 임명희 대변인은 “명태균의 사기 공갈극이 아니라 오 시장의 대국민 사기 공갈극이었다”고 했다.)

Spokesperson Lim continued, "Meanwhile, Mayor Oh has claimed innocence, portraying his meetings with Mr. Myung as close to one-sided stalking and dismissing him as part of a con artist group," and "As a fifth-term Seoul mayor, he has consistently and shamelessly lied to the entire nation." (임 대변인은 “그동안 오 시장은 결백을 주장했다. 명씨와의 만남을 일방적 스토킹에 가깝다며 사기꾼 집단으로 몰았다”며 “5선 서울시장이라는 공직자 신분으로 전 국민 앞에서 시종일관 뻔뻔하게 거짓말한 것”이라고 했다.)

Spokesperson Lim further said, "Mayor Oh may continue his legal disputes as an individual, but as a public official, he should have at least apologized to the people first." (임 대변인은 이어 “오 시장이 개인으로서 법리적 다툼은 이어갈 수 있지만, 공직자로서 최소한 국민께 먼저 사과했어야 한다”고 했다.)

Spokesperson Lim also targeted the People Power Party. She stated, "From Yoon Seok-youl and former lawmaker Kwon Seong-dong to the current Mayor Oh, violations of the Political Funds Act are being proven one after another," adding, "At this point, they should acknowledge the serious flaws in their candidate nomination system and sincerely apologize for the waste of taxpayer money caused by repeated by-elections." She also said, "The People Power Party has become a party that can even produce a president through manipulated opinion polls, bribery, collusion with pseudo-religions, and organized party enrollment." (임 대변인은 국민의힘도 겨냥했다. 그는 “윤석열, 권성동 전 의원에 이어 현직 오 시장에 이르기까지 정치자금법 위반 행태가 줄줄이 입증되고 있다”며 “이 정도면 공천 관리 시스템의 심각한 결함을 인정하고, 거듭되는 재보궐선거로 인한 혈세 낭비를 진심으로 머리 숙여 사죄해야 한다”고 했다. “국민의힘이 조작된 여론조사와 금품 매수, 사이비 종교와의 결탁과 조직적 입당만으로도 대통령까지 만들어내는 정당이 돼 버렸다”고도 했다.)

Spokesperson Lim urged, "Mayor Oh should stop deceiving citizens with meaningless delays and immediately resign from his position as mayor," concluding, "Restoring the normal functioning of Seoul city government as soon as possible is the last duty Mayor Oh can fulfill for the people and Seoul citizens." (임 대변인은 “오 시장은 더 이상 무의미한 시간 끌기로 시민을 기만하지 말고 즉각 시장직에서 사퇴하라”며 “하루빨리 서울시정을 정상화하는 것만이 오 시장이 국민과 서울시민에게 할 수 있는 마지막 도리”라고 했다.)

item.title: Anti-Corruption Commission: "Family Members Living with Public Rental Housing Tenants Should Be Able to Continue Residing Even Without Registering Their Residency" (권익위 “공공임대주택 임차인과 함께 산 가족, 주민등록 안 했어도 계속 살 수 있어야”)
item.description:
Anti-Corruption Commission: "Family Members Living with Public Rental Housing Tenants Should Be Able to Continue Residing Even Without Registering Their Residency" (권익위 “공공임대주택 임차인과 함께 산 가족, 주민등록 안 했어도 계속 살 수 있어야”)

On the 22nd, the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission recommended that local urban development corporations nationwide establish a system to relieve individuals who lived with a tenant in public rental housing but failed to transfer their address to that housing, thereby losing the right to inherit the rental lease after the tenant's death. <<> According to the Commission, under current regulations, if a public rental housing tenant dies, a spouse or child who cohabited and is entitled to inheritance can succeed to the rental lease and continue residing, provided they are homeless. Public institutions operating rental housing verify cohabitation based on the address registered on the resident registration. <<> However, many public rental housing residents do not transfer their address to the rental housing due to concerns over debts that could lead to the seizure of deposits. Although this violates the Resident Registration Act, the Korea Land and Housing Corporation (LH) has its own regulations to relieve these individuals, considering they are vulnerable groups. This allows heirs to succeed to the lease by proving actual cohabitation, even if their address is not the rental housing. Yet, some local urban development corporations, such as the Seoul Housing and Communities Corporation (SH) and the Gyeonggi Housing and Urban Development Corporation (GH), lack such regulations, and thus do not allow succession for heirs whose address is not the rental housing. <<> The Commission recommended that local urban development corporations establish regulations to permit lease succession upon confirmation of actual cohabitation, regardless of the registered address. <<> The Commission also advised that if credit card usage records are required to verify cohabitation, low-credit individuals who cannot obtain credit cards may struggle to prove their cohabitation. It recommended checking other materials, such as mobile phone call logs. <<> Han Sam-seok, Vice Chairperson and Secretary General of the Commission, stated, "This recommendation is meaningful in preventing vulnerable groups, who were unable to transfer their residency due to unavoidable circumstances, from being evicted from rental housing, thereby resolving blind spots in housing welfare." He added, "We will continue to listen to on-the-ground voices to improve systems and provide practical help to the public's housing stability." (공공 임대주택에 임차인과 함께 살았으나 해당 주택으로 주소지를 옮겨두지 않아 임차인 사망 후 임대주택 임차권을 승계받지 못하는 사람들을 구제하는 제도를 마련하라고 국민권익위원회가 22일 전국의 지방 도시공사에 권고했다.)

item.title: [Breaking News] President Lee to Meet Jensen Huang and Sam Altman in the US ([속보] 李대통령, 美서 젠슨 황·올트먼 만난다)
item.description:
[Breaking News] President Lee to Meet Jensen Huang and Sam Altman in the US ([속보] 李대통령, 美서 젠슨 황·올트먼 만난다)

President Lee Jae-myung will visit San Francisco, USA on the 24th (local time) to meet with global big tech giants, including NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang, as well as the CEOs of Anthropic, OpenAI, and Broadcom. President Lee will also embark on a tour of the United States and three South American countries from the 24th to the 3rd of next month. (이재명 대통령이 24일(현지 시각) 미국 샌프란시스코를 방문해 젠슨 황 엔비디아 CEO를 비롯해 앤트로픽, 오픈AI, 브로드컴 CEO 등 글로벌 빅테크의 거물들을 잇달아 만난다. 또 이 대통령은 24일부터 다음 달 3일까지 미국과 남미 3국 순방길에 오른다.)

Cheong Wa Dae Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom said at a briefing at the Chuncheon Pavilion on the 22nd, "President Lee will arrive in San Francisco on the morning of the 24th and hold meetings with global big tech CEOs. He will sequentially meet with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang, and Broadcom President and CEO Hock Tan." (김용범 청와대 정책실장은 22일 춘추관 브리핑에서 “이 대통령은 24일 오전 샌프란시스코에 도착해 글로벌 빅테크 기업 CEO(최고경영자)를 면담하게 된다”며 “다리오 아모데이 앤트로픽 CEO, 샘 올트먼 오픈AI CEO, 젠슨 황 엔비디아 CEO, 혹탄 브로드컴 사장 겸 CEO를 순차적으로 만난다”고 했다.)

Separately, President Lee will also participate in an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Summit event alongside US big tech officials and domestic business leaders, including Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong, SK Chairman崔태원, Hyundai Motor Group Chairman Chung Eui-sun, and Naver Chairperson Lee Hae-jin. (이 대통령은 이와 별도로 미국 빅테크 관계자들과 함께 이재용 삼성전자 회장, 최태원 SK 회장, 정의선 현대차그룹 회장, 이해진 네이버 의장 등 국내 기업인들이 참여하는 인공지능(AI) 서밋 행사에도 참여한다.)

President Lee is scheduled to depart from San Francisco, USA on the 24th, visiting Brazil, Chile, and Argentina, then passing through Frankfurt, Germany, and returning home on the 3rd of next month. (이 대통령은 24일부터 미국 샌프란시스코를 시작으로 브라질, 칠레, 아르헨티나를 방문한 뒤 독일 프랑크푸르트를 거쳐 다음 달 3일 귀국할 예정이다.)

Cheong Wa Dae National Security Director Wi Sung-rak stated at a briefing at the Chuncheon Pavilion on the 22nd, "President Lee will visit San Francisco in the US, Brazil, Chile, and Argentina from the 24th to August 3rd, and will return home via Frankfurt, Germany." (위성락 청와대 국가안보실장은 22일 춘추관 브리핑에서 “이 대통령은 24일부터 8월 3일까지 미국의 샌프란시스코, 브라질, 칠레, 아르헨티나를 방문하고 독일의 프랑크푸르트를 거쳐서 귀국한다”고 밝혔다.)

President Lee will pay a state visit to Brazil on the 26th (local time) at the invitation of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. After a summit with President Lula on the 27th, he will attend a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) signing ceremony, a joint press conference, and a state luncheon. On the 28th, he will move to São Paulo, Brazil, to participate in a luncheon meeting with overseas compatriots and the Korea-Brazil Business Roundtable. (이 대통령은 26일(현지 시각) 루이스 이나시우 룰라 다 시우바 대통령의 초청으로 브라질을 국빈 방문한다. 27일 룰라 대통령과의 정상회담을 가진 후 양해각서(MOU) 서명식, 공동 언론 발표, 국빈 오찬 일정을 소화한다. 28일에는 브라질 상파울루로 이동해 동포 오찬 간담회와 한·브라질 비즈니스 라운드테이블에 참석한다.)

From the 29th to the 30th, he will make an official visit to Chile, holding a summit with President José Antonio Kast of Chile's new government, which was inaugurated this year. (29~30일에는 칠레를 공식 방문해 올해 출범한 칠레 신정부의 호세 안토니오 카스트 대통령과 정상회담을 갖는다.)

President Lee will visit Argentina from the 30th to August 1st. This marks the first official visit by a South Korean president in 22 years. (이 대통령은 30일부터 8월 1일까지 아르헨티나를 방문한다. 우리나라 대통령으로서 22년 만의 공식 방문이다.)

Regarding the expected outcomes of the tour to the three South American countries, Director Wi stated, "We aim to expand trade and investment and open new markets with Brazil, Chile, and Argentina, which are key economic powers in South America." He added, "In summits with Brazil and Argentina, which lead Mercosur (the Southern Common Market), we will discuss resuming negotiations for a Korea-Mercosur trade agreement, and with Chile, our first free trade agreement (FTA) partner, we will discuss modernizing the FTA." <<>> (위 실장은 남미 3국 순방 기대 성과와 관련해 “남미 핵심 경제 대국인 브라질, 칠레, 아르헨티나와의 교역·투자 확대와 시장 개척”이라며 “메르코수르(Mercosur·남아메리카 공동시장)를 주도하는 브라질과 아르헨티나와의 정상회담에서 한·메르코수르 무역 협정 협상 재개를 논의하고, 우리의 첫 자유무역협정(FTA) 체결국인 칠레와는 FTA 현대화를 논의한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Yong-beom: "Additional Leverage Measures Are Ahead of Schedule... Prompt Implementation of Existing Measures Is Urgent" (김용범 “레버리지 추가 대책은 앞선 말... 기존 대책 신속 이행이 급선무”)
item.description:
Kim Yong-beom: "Additional Leverage Measures Are Ahead of Schedule... Prompt Implementation of Existing Measures Is Urgent" (김용범 “레버리지 추가 대책은 앞선 말... 기존 대책 신속 이행이 급선무”)

Kim Yong-beom, head of the presidential office's policy office, stated on the 22nd regarding President Lee Jae-myung's directive for prompt supplementary measures on single-stock leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs) that "this was not a mention of new additional measures." He then referenced the government's recently announced regulatory plans for leveraged ETFs, saying, "Prompt implementation is the urgent priority." (김용범 청와대 정책실장은 22일 이재명 대통령이 단일종목 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF)에 대한 신속 보완을 지시한 것에 대해 “새로운 추가 대책을 말씀하신 것은 아니다”라고 했다. 그러면서 정부가 최근 내놓은 레버리지 ETF 규제 방안을 언급하며 “신속하게 이행하는 것이 급선무”라고 했다.)

During a briefing at the presidential office that day, Director Kim explained, "(The President) was asking when the already announced measures will be implemented and spoke with the intent of finding ways to speed up their execution." After Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix leveraged ETFs were identified as one of the factors fueling stock market instability, President Lee had said, "Supplementary measures must be prepared promptly and thoroughly." (김 실장은 이날 청와대 브리핑에서 “(이 대통령이) 이미 발표한 대책이 언제 시행되는지를 묻고, 좀 더 빨리 시행할 방안을 찾으라는 취지로 말한 것으로 이해한다”며 이같이 말했다. 삼성전자·하이닉스 레버리지 ETF가 증시 불안을 부추기는 원인 중 하나로 지목되자, 이 대통령은 “보완책을 신속하고 충실하게 만들어야 한다”고 했었다.)

Regarding this, Director Kim added, "The previously announced measures involve significant changes, so prompt implementation is the urgent priority. We need to assess their effects and review necessary supplements—since the effects have not yet materialized, saying anything additional is getting ahead of ourselves." This refers to the Financial Services Commission's measures on the 16th, which raised the minimum deposit for new purchases from 10 million won to 30 million won, among other steps to increase barriers for investor entry, indicating that implementing these first is essential. (이에 대해 김 실장은 “지난번 발표한 내용이 꽤 큰 변화를 포함한 대책들이라 신속하게 이행하는 것이 급선무”라며 “그 효과를 보고 필요한 부분 보완을 검토해야지, 아직 효과가 드러난 것이 아니기 때문에 추가로 뭔가를 더 한다는 것은 앞서나간 말”이라고 덧붙였다. 앞서 금융위원회가 16일 신규 매수를 위한 기본 예탁금을 1000만원에서 3000만원으로 올리는 등 투자자 진입 장벽을 높이는 대책을 내놨는데, 이를 선(先) 이행하는 게 필요하다는 뜻이다.)

However, regarding a previous interview where he mentioned optimizing the selling burden to align the divergence rate (the difference between an ETF's net asset value and its actual market price), he said, "I think there might be room for flexible interpretation of the divergence rate and for dialogue between authorities and the industry." (다만 앞서 방송 인터뷰에서 괴리율(ETF의 순자산가치와 실제 시장 가격 간 차이)을 맞추기 위한 매도 부담의 적정화를 언급한 것에 대해선 “괴리율 부분을 유연하게 해석한다든지 당국과 업계가 대화할 부분이 있지 않을까 생각한다”고 했다.)

On President Lee's mention of the "Yellow Envelope Act" the previous day, raising concerns about the excessive expansion of labor dispute targets, Director Kim drew a line, saying, "I don't think the President expressed concerns about the Yellow Envelope Act itself." He explained, "If controversies arise due to unclear guidelines, there's a risk of it escalating into debates framed as being caused by the Yellow Envelope Act, so he said it would be good for the Ministry of Employment and Labor to clarify its stance through guidelines or similar means. It's not about blaming the Yellow Envelope Act." (김 실장은 전날 이 대통령이 노란봉투법을 언급하며 노동쟁의 대상이 지나치게 확장되는 문제를 거론한 데 대해서는 “대통령이 노란봉투법에 대해 우려하셨다고는 생각하지 않는다”고 선을 그었다. 그는 “명확하게 지침이 마련되지 않아 논란이 되면, 노란봉투법 때문이라는 식의 논쟁으로 번질 가능성이 있으니 고용노동부가 지침 등으로 명확하게 입장을 정리하면 좋겠다고 말씀하신 것”이라며 “노란봉투법 때문이라는 뜻이 아니다”라고 했다.)

Regarding the impact of the Yellow Envelope Act, he said, "Like the saying 'Is the glass half full or half empty?'—whether it's positive or negative depends on one's judgment," but added, "At least there hasn't been a case where bargaining units fragmented chaotically to the point where the primary contractor lost control." He continued, "After one or two years, once the Yellow Envelope Act is settled, both positive aspects and areas for improvement will emerge. We can then evaluate and adjust accordingly." (또 노란봉투법의 여파에 대해 “‘물컵에 물이 반이나 있느냐, 반밖에 없느냐’는 말처럼 긍정적인지 부정적인지는 각자의 판정”이라면서도 “적어도 교섭 단위가 마구 분화돼서 원청이 정신을 차리지 못하는 일은 발생하지 않았다”고 했다. 이어 “1∼2년이 지나 노란봉투법이 정착되면 좋은 점과 개선할 점이 나타날 것”이라며 “그에 따라 평가하고 고쳐나가면 된다”고 했다.)

item.title: S. Korea, US, Japan FMs Meet Again in 2 Weeks, Vow to Maintain Robust Deterrence Against N. Korea (2주 만에 만난 한미일 외교장관 “견고한 대북억제 태세 유지”)
item.description:
S. Korea, US, Japan FMs Meet Again in 2 Weeks, Vow to Maintain Robust Deterrence Against N. Korea (2주 만에 만난 한미일 외교장관 “견고한 대북억제 태세 유지”)

The foreign ministers of South Korea, the United States, and Japan met in Manila, the Philippines, on the 22nd (local time), reaffirming the principle of denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula and agreeing to strengthen trilateral coordination on North Korea. This meeting took place roughly two weeks after their previous trilateral foreign ministers' meeting held on the sidelines of the NATO summit on the 7th. (한·미·일 외교장관이 22일(현지 시각) 필리핀 마닐라에서 만나 한반도 비핵화 원칙을 재확인하고, 대북 공조를 강화해 나가기로 했다. 한·미·일 외교장관 만남은 지난 7일 북대서양조약기구(NATO·나토) 정상회의를 계기로 3국 외교장관 회의를 가진 이후 약 2주 만이다.)

South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Hyun, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, and Japanese Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi held a trilateral foreign ministers' meeting for about 30 minutes that afternoon at the Philippine International Convention Center (PICC). (조현 외교부 장관과 마코 루비오 미국 국무장관, 모테기 도시미쓰 일본 외무상은 이날 오후 필리핀국제컨벤션센터(PICC)에서 약 30분간 외교장관 회의를 했다.)

According to Seoul's foreign ministry, the three ministers shared assessments of the recent situation on the Korean Peninsula and reaffirmed their position to maintain a robust deterrence posture against North Korea while upholding the principle of its denuclearization. (외교부에 따르면 한·미·일 외교장관들은 최근 한반도 정세에 대한 평가를 공유하고, 한반도 비핵화 원칙을 견지하는 가운데 견고한 대북 억제 태세를 유지해 나간다는 입장을 재확인했다.)

They also agreed to maintain close coordination on North Korea policy and cooperate in maintaining peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula through dialogue and diplomacy. (또 대북 정책 관련 긴밀한 공조를 유지하고, 대화와 외교를 통한 한반도 평화·안정 유지에도 협력하기로 했다.)

The three ministers discussed regional and global situations, including Northeast Asia and the Middle East, and shared the view on the need to strengthen communication and policy coordination among South Korea, the US, and Japan amid the growing uncertainties in the international landscape. (3국 장관들은 동북아와 중동 등 지역·글로벌 정세를 논의하고, 불확실성이 커지는 국제 정세 속에서 한·미·일 간 소통과 정책 공조를 강화할 필요가 있다는 데 뜻을 같이했다.)

The foreign ministry stated, "They exchanged views on the regional situation, including attempts to unilaterally change the status quo, and reaffirmed their commitment to upholding international law as reflected in the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) and strengthening maritime security, including freedom of navigation and overflight, and lawful uses of the sea in the Indo-Pacific region, including Southeast Asia." The mention of 'attempts to unilaterally change the status quo' appears to refer to China's expansion of its territorial claims in the South China Sea. (외교부는 “현상을 일방적으로 변경하려는 시도를 포함해 역내 정세에 대한 의견을 교환했으며, 동남아시아를 포함한 인도·태평양 지역에서 항행 및 상공 비행의 자유, 해양의 합법적 이용 등 유엔해양법협약에 반영된 국제법 준수와 해양 안보 강화에 대한 의지를 재확인했다”고 밝혔다. ‘현상을 일방적으로 변경하려는 시도’는 중국의 남중국해 영유권 확대 시도를 의미하는 것으로 보인다.)

The three foreign ministers also agreed to expand cooperation in areas such as responding to transnational crimes, disaster relief, and humanitarian assistance, and to continue consultations to produce concrete results. (3국 외교장관은 또 초국경 범죄 대응과 재난 구호, 인도적 지원 분야 협력을 확대하고 구체적인 성과를 도출하기 위한 협의를 이어가기로 했다.)

In the field of economic security, they decided to deepen practical cooperation in nuclear energy, critical minerals, and key emerging technologies, and to expand cooperation in areas including diversifying and enhancing the resilience of supply chains, responding to economic coercion, and Arctic security. (경제안보 분야에서는 원자력과 핵심 광물, 핵심 신흥 기술 분야에서 실질 협력을 심화하고 공급망 다변화와 회복력 증진, 경제적 강압 대응, 북극 안보 등 분야에서도 협력을 확대하기로 했다.)

Prior to this meeting, Minister Cho held a brief conversation of about five minutes with US Deputy Secretary of State for Political Affairs Alison Hooker. It is also known that he had a separate dialogue with Secretary Rubio on the sidelines of the trilateral meeting. Accordingly, attention is focused on whether they exchanged views on pending bilateral issues such as follow-up consultations in the security field between South Korea and the US, investment in the US, or the Coupang issue. (조 장관은 이날 회의에 앞서 앨리슨 후커 미 국무부 정무차관과 약 5분간 환담했다. 루비오 장관과도 한·미·일 외교장관 회의를 계기로 별도 대화를 나눈 것으로 알려졌다. 이에 따라 한미 간 안보 분야 후속 협의나 대미 투자, 쿠팡 문제 등 한미 간 현안에 대해 의견 교환이 이뤄졌을지 주목된다.)

item.title: Cho: "Instability in the Middle East, No One Can Safeguard Security Alone" (조현 “중동 지역 불안정, 혼자 힘으로 안보 지켜낼 수 없어”)
item.description:
Cho: "Instability in the Middle East, No One Can Safeguard Security Alone" (조현 “중동 지역 불안정, 혼자 힘으로 안보 지켜낼 수 없어”)

Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul stated on the 22nd (local time), "In the midst of global supply chain disruptions, instability in the Middle East, and rapid technological innovation, no country can safeguard its prosperity and security solely through its own efforts." (조현 외교부 장관은 22일(현지 시각) “글로벌 공급망 교란과 중동 지역의 불안정, 급속한 기술 혁신 속에서 어느 나라도 혼자만의 힘으로 번영과 안보를 지켜낼 수 없다”고 말했다.)

At the 29th ASEAN-ROK Foreign Ministers' Meeting held in Manila, the Philippines, Minister Cho emphasized that "ASEAN is a reliable partner" and pledged to strengthen cooperation in areas such as artificial intelligence (AI), cultural creative industries, and combating transnational crime. (조 장관은 이날 필리핀 마닐라에서 열린 제29차 한·아세안 외교장관 회의에서 “아세안은 신뢰할 수 있는 파트너”라며 인공지능(AI), 문화창조산업, 초국가 범죄 대응 등 분야에서 협력을 강화하겠다고 했다.)

Minister Cho remarked, "President Lee Jae-myung has consistently stressed the importance of solidarity among reliable partners, and for Korea, ASEAN is precisely such a partner." (조 장관은 “이재명 대통령은 신뢰할 수 있는 파트너 간 연대의 중요성을 강조해왔고, 한국에게 아세안은 바로 그러한 파트너”라고 했다.)

Minister Cho outlined the implementation plan for the "Korea-ASEAN Comprehensive Strategic Partnership (CSP) Vision," centered on the vision of a Contributor enabling dreams and hopes, a Springboard for growth and innovation, and a Partner for peace and stability, and requested support from ASEAN member states. (조 장관은 꿈과 희망을 이루는 조력자(Contributor), 성장과 혁신의 도약대(Springboard), 평화와 안정의 파트너(Partner) 비전을 중심으로 ‘한-아세안 포괄적 전략 동반자 관계(CSP) 비전’의 이행 계획을 설명하고 아세안 회원국들의 지지를 당부했다.)

He particularly noted that Korea would push forward cooperation to build an AI ecosystem and foster research and talent development based on Korea's AI capabilities. Additionally, he introduced the Cultural Creative Industries Initiative and joint efforts against scam crimes as key cooperative projects. (특히 한국의 AI 역량을 바탕으로 AI 생태계 구축과 연구·인재 양성을 위한 협력을 추진해 나갈 것이라고 했다. 또 문화 창조 산업 이니셔티브와 스캠(사기) 범죄 공동 대응도 주요 협력 사업으로 소개했다.)

ASEAN member states welcomed the "Korea-ASEAN CSP Vision" proposed by President Lee Jae-myung at the ASEAN Summit in October of last year, and expressed their hope to cooperate closely with Korea in the specific implementation process going forward. (아세안 회원국들은 지난해 10월 아세안 정상회의에서 이재명 대통령이 제시한 ‘한·아세안 CSP 비전’을 환영하며, 향후 구체적인 이행 과정에서 한국과 긴밀히 협력해 나가기를 희망한다고 했다.)

Minister Cho also explained the Korean government's efforts to realize a Korean Peninsula where the two Koreas coexist peacefully and grow together, and ASEAN member states reaffirmed their support for the government's policy on the Korean Peninsula. (조 장관은 또 남북이 평화롭게 공존하고 함께 성장하는 한반도를 구현하기 위한 우리 정부의 노력을 설명했으며 아세안 회원국들은 정부의 한반도 정책에 대한 지지를 재확인했다.)

item.title: Wi Sung-rak: "U.S. Likely to Impose Additional Tariffs Under Section 301 or Other Provisions" (위성락 “美, 301조 또는 다른 조항으로 추가 관세 가능성”)
item.description:
Wi Sung-rak: "U.S. Likely to Impose Additional Tariffs Under Section 301 or Other Provisions" (위성락 “美, 301조 또는 다른 조항으로 추가 관세 가능성”)

Wi Sung-rak, Director of the National Security Office at the White House, stated on the 22nd regarding the ongoing investigation under Section 301 of the Trade Act by the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR) against South Korea and others, "I believe there is a possibility of additional tariffs." (위성락 청와대 국가안보실장은 22일 미 무역대표부(USTR)가 한국 등을 상대로 진행 중인 무역법 301조 조사와 관련해 “추가적인 관세가 있을 수 있다고 생각한다”고 밝혔다.)

During a meeting with reporters at the Cheong Wa Dae press center, Director Wi said, "The Section 301 issue is fundamentally about forced labor and overproduction, and how it will be applied is open to interpretation," adding, "It could be Section 301, it could be other provisions, and I think there could be additional tariffs." (위 실장은 이날 청와대 춘추관에서 기자들과 만나 “301조 문제는 기본적으로 강제 노동, 과잉 생산과 관련이 있는데 (어떻게 적용할지는) 해석하기 나름”이라며 “301조일 수 있고, 다른 조항일 수 있고, 추가적인 관세가 있을 수 있다고 생각한다”고 했다.)

Section 301 of the Trade Act is a powerful tool that allows for comprehensive retaliatory measures without a ceiling on tariff rates against unfair trade practices of other countries. After the U.S. Supreme Court ruled in February that the reciprocal tariffs imposed in April last year were unlawful, the Trump administration has been discussing ways to apply Section 301. (무역법 301조는 상대국의 불공정 무역 관행에 대해 관세율 상한선 없이 전방위적 보복 조치를 할 수 있는 강력한 수단이다. 지난해 4월 부과한 상호 관세가 지난 2월 미 연방 대법원에서 위법 판결이 나자, 트럼프 정부는 무역법 301조를 적용할 방법을 논의해왔다.)

Director Wi said, "Generally, we understand that even if there are Section 301 measures, they will not exceed the overall tariff rates agreed upon under the Korea-U.S. tariff deal," and noted, "We are in consultations with the U.S. and are providing necessary data and explanations." (위 실장은 “대체로 우리가 양해하고 있는 것은 301조 조치가 있더라도 한미 간 관세합의한 큰 세율은 초과하지 않는 것으로 이해하고 있다”며 “미국과 협의하고 있고 우리가 필요한 자료 제공이나 설명을 하고 있다”고 했다.)

He further mentioned the recent U.S. announcement to impose new 50% tariffs on some Canadian products, saying, "Since they are invoking provisions that have rarely been used before, there could be various moves to impose tariffs." According to a fact sheet released by the White House, the additional tariffs applied to Canada are based on Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930. (이어 미국이 최근 일부 캐나다산 제품에 50%의 새로운 관세를 부과하겠다고 발표한 것을 거론하며 “거의 작동된 적 없는 조항을 원용하기도 하기 때문에 여러 방식의 관세 부과 움직임이 있을 수 있겠다”고 했다. 백악관이 발표한 팩트시트에 따르면, 캐나다에게 적용된 추가 관세는 1930년 제정된 관세법 338조를 근거로 하고 있다.)

item.title: Opposition Says 'Oh's First Trial Sentence Losing Mayor Post Will Be Corrected in Appeal' (野, ‘吳 1심 시장직 상실형’에 “항소심서 바로 잡히길”)
item.description:
Opposition Says 'Oh's First Trial Sentence Losing Mayor Post Will Be Corrected in Appeal' (野, ‘吳 1심 시장직 상실형’에 “항소심서 바로 잡히길”)

People Power Party floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik said on the 22nd regarding Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon receiving a sentence losing his mayor post in the first trial for the 'opinion poll proxy payment' charges, "A ruling should be made based on strict evidence and facts, not on circumstances and preconceptions." (국민의힘 정점식 원내대표는 22일 오세훈 서울시장이 ‘여론조사 대납’ 혐의로 1심에서 시장직 상실형을 선고받은 데 대해 “판결은 엄밀한 증거와 사실을 바탕으로 이뤄져야지, 정황과 예단을 바탕으로 이뤄져선 안 된다”고 했다.)

Earlier, the 22nd Criminal Division (Presiding Judge Jo Hyeong-woo) of the Seoul Central District Court sentenced Mayor Oh to a fine of 10 million won and an additional surcharge of 21 million won. (앞서 서울중앙지법 형사합의22부(재판장 조형우)는 이날 오 시장에게 벌금 1000만원과 2100만원 추징을 선고했다.)

In a statement released that day, Floor Leader Jeong said, "We respect the judgments of courts at all levels, but I wonder if a guilty verdict can be rendered solely based on a judge's preconceptions that rely entirely on Myung Tae-kyun's testimony." Jeong added, "The court itself acknowledged that 'Myung Tae-kyun's statements from the investigative agency to this court have been inconsistent,'" and "I expect more thorough verification and judgment to take place in the appellate trial." (정 원내대표는 이날 발표한 입장문에서 “각급 법원의 판단은 존중하지만, 하지만 전적으로 명태균의 진술에 의존한 판사의 예단만으로 유죄 판결을 내릴 수 있는지 의문”이라면서 이렇게 말했다. 정 원내대표는 “법원도 ‘명태균이 수사 기관에서 이 법정에 이르기까지 진술한 내용이 일관되지 않다’는 점을 인정했다”며 “항소심에서 보다 면밀한 검증과 판단이 이뤄지길 기대한다”고 했다.)

Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon said on Facebook that day, "Today's first trial guilty verdict for Mayor Oh is hard to accept because the testimony of those involved lacks credibility and has many leaps in logic," adding, "I hope it will be corrected in the appeal." (무소속 한동훈 의원은 이날 페이스북에서 “오 시장에 대한 오늘 1심 유죄 판결은 관련자 증언의 신빙성이 떨어지고 비약이 많아 납득하기 어렵다”며 “항소심에서 바로잡히기를 바란다”고 했다.)

People Power Party lawmaker Ahn Cheol-soo said on Facebook, "Today's ruling is a first trial judgment, and there is a long legal process ahead," and "Above all, I hope Mayor Oh does not get disheartened and continues to manage Seoul's municipal affairs without wavering." (국민의힘 안철수 의원은 페이스북에서 “오늘 판결은 1심 판단으로, 앞으로 긴 법적 절차가 남아 있다”며 “무엇보다 오 시장은 상심하지 마시고, 서울시정에 흔들림 없이 임해주시길 바란다”고 했다.)

The Democratic Party of Korea said toward Mayor Oh, "We hope he humbly acknowledges his crime and fulfills his legal and political responsibilities." Democratic Party senior spokesperson Kang Jun-hyeon said in a written briefing that day, "This is a result of 'justice prevailing' in a clear crime of receiving survey results from a political broker and having a donor pay the costs." (더불어민주당은 오 시장을 향해 “자신의 죄를 겸허히 인정하고 법적, 정치적 책임을 다하기를 바란다”고 했다. 민주당 강준현 수석대변인은 이날 서면 브리핑에서 “정치 브로커에게 여론조사 결과를 제공받고 후원자에게 비용을 대납시킨 명백한 범죄에 대한 ‘사필귀정’의 결과”라고 했다.)

Spokesperson Kang said, "The fact that Mayor Oh used opinion polls commissioned by a political broker for his election and had a donor pay those costs has been proven in court," adding, "This is a clear violation of the Political Funds Act and undermines the electoral system itself, which is the foundation of democracy." (강 대변인은 “오 시장이 정치 브로커에 의뢰한 여론조사를 선거에 활용했고 그 비용을 후원자에게 대납시켰다는 사실이 법원에서 입증된 것”이라며 “이는 명백한 정치자금법 위반이자 민주주의 근간인 선거 제도 자체를 훼손한 것”이라고 했다.)

He continued, "Until right before the sentencing, Mayor Oh claimed that the special prosecutor and the Democratic Party were forcing a false conviction, showing a brazen attitude without any remorse," and "There is no room for pathetic excuses before the judiciary's stern ruling." (그러면서 “오 시장은 선고 직전까지도 특검과 민주당이 억지 유죄를 강요한다고 주장하면서 반성은커녕 뻔뻔한 태도를 일관해왔다”며 “사법부의 엄중한 판결 앞에 구차한 변명은 설 자리가 없다”고 했다.)

item.title: Yoo Si-min Keeps Targeting Lee… Within Party: "A Warning Against the Reality of Charges Being Dropped" (계속 李 저격하는 유시민… 與내부 “공소취소 현실화에 대한 경고”)
item.description:
Yoo Si-min Keeps Targeting Lee… Within Party: "A Warning Against the Reality of Charges Being Dropped" (계속 李 저격하는 유시민… 與내부 “공소취소 현실화에 대한 경고”)

Yoo Si-min, who positions himself as a pro-government speaker, has been sharply criticizing President Lee Jae-myung day after day. On the surface, he targets the President's pragmatic line and expansion of appeal to embrace moderates and conservatives through arguments of "rebuilding" and "inevitable defeat." However, Democratic Party figures close to Yoo stated on the 22nd that the real reason for his harsh words toward a president who has just entered his second year in power is "a warning against the movement to drop charges in the President's case led by the pro-Lee faction." They explained that the ultimate goal of the traditional pro-government support base, represented by Yoo, is the re-election of the administration, and if the dropping of charges—which would effectively end the President's ongoing trial—becomes a reality, they believe it would lead to an inevitable defeat in both the next general election and the presidential election. <<> Appearing on a YouTube channel on the night of the 21st, Yoo said, "The actions of 'New Lee Jae-myung' are not a riot staged by the 'self-proclaimed pro-Lee faction,' but something planned and initiated by the President and some aides we don't know well shortly after taking office." He added, "It's highly likely that President Lee is the head of 'New Lee Jae-myung.'" When asked why he criticizes a president who has only been in office for a year, he replied, "Even a fish shop selling the best quality fish will inevitably smell fishy," and "If you leave that without any criticism or restrictions, every fish shop will end up reeking." He also said, "Democracy is a system that prevents even evil and bad people from doing as they please when they become the highest authority." <<> Yoo also strongly criticized the cautious stance spreading within the Democratic Party against the complete abolition of prosecutors' supplementary investigation powers. "I think this is the President's intention," he said. Claiming there have been signs of backtracking on prosecution reform since last fall, he stated, "My hypothesis is that the President wants to preserve prosecutors' investigative powers," and "The President hasn't given up on this even now." Yoo did not mention why the President might want to retain these supplementary investigation powers. However, supporters commented, "Isn't it because of the dropping of charges?" This revives the "prosecution reform and dropping of charges deal theory" first raised earlier this year on a pro-government YouTube channel hosted by Kim Eo-jun. Cheon Ho-seon, a former senior presidential secretary who worked with Yoo in the Roh Moo-hyun administration, also posted on Facebook that day, saying, "Has the President broken principles and promises, making deals and compromises out of concern for his own well-being after leaving office?" and "It has now come to a point where the President needs to speak up." <<> Democratic Party figures close to Yoo said, "Yoo just doesn't mention the dropping of charges because it's like touching a raw nerve, but his inner concerns are about that very issue." Yoo, while appearing on the pro-government YouTube show "Maebul Show," also said, "The President must be prevented from meddling with 'Myung-pick' [Lee's preferred candidates]. But there have been many instances of such interference." One Democratic Party lawmaker remarked, "The reason the President keeps sending the message that 'Kim Min-seok should be the next Democratic Party leader,' despite controversy over his interference in party affairs, is likely because he needs a close associate as party leader to strengthen the push for dropping the charges." A key pro-government source said, "Yoo already witnessed the backlash against dropping charges during the June local elections, so he believes that if the new party leader pushes for it again, approval ratings will plummet, ruining the 2028 general election and the 2030 presidential election." Before the local elections, the Democratic Party had pushed for a special counsel probe into the alleged fabricated indictment related to the President's case, but backtracked due to backlash. Pro-Lee lawmakers are now saying, "If former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok becomes party leader, he will revive the special counsel push." <<> The pro-Lee faction has strongly criticized Yoo, calling him a "traitor." Kim Min-seok, the former Prime Minister and a party leadership candidate, said that day, "Politics that distorts and twists the President's own words and sincerity, crossing the line of commentary, has also lost its restraint and dignity," adding, "False prophecies predicting the failure of the Lee Jae-myung administration will fail again this time." Lawmaker Lim Mi-ae, who is running for a Supreme Council seat while backing Kim for party leader, said on SBS Radio, "I wondered why he had to bring this up again at this particular time." She added, "With the preliminary primary [cutoff] underway, I think this is a very cleverly timed message to rally a specific support base and get them to vote." <<> One pro-Lee figure said, "It sounds absurd to hear the old mainstream factions of the Democratic Party—the pro-Roh and pro-Moon groups represented by Yoo—telling the President, 'This is our party, don't interfere anymore.'" However, Yoo has recently told those around him, "I am not a person who will pursue politics. I was someone who said we should move forward together centered on Lee Jae-myung during the last presidential election. Everything I say comes from a sincere desire for President Lee to succeed in his re-election bid." The presidential office is not directly responding to Yoo's remarks. <<> The rift within the pro-government camp appears to be accelerating ahead of the Democratic Party's national convention. With the new mainstream pro-Lee faction backing former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok for the next party leader, and the pro-Roh and pro-Moon support base backing former Representative Chung Chung-rae, tensions between the two sides are escalating. One lawmaker whose constituency is in the Honam region said, "If they keep fighting each other like this to the death, depending on who becomes party leader, a split within the party is even possible." Some have also suggested, "Isn't Yoo's antagonism toward the pro-Lee faction part of a larger plan to position former Justice Minister and former Rebuilding Korea Party leader Cho Kuk, who is close to the pro-Moon and pro-Roh factions, as the next presidential candidate?" (친여 스피커를 자처하는 유시민씨가 연일 이재명 대통령을 강도 높게 비판하고 있다. 표면적으로는 ‘재건축론’ ‘필패론’을 내세워 이 대통령의 중도·보수까지 껴안는 외연 확장, 실용주의 노선을 겨냥한 것이다. 하지만 유씨와 가까운 더불어민주당 인사들은 22일 유씨가 정권 2년 차로 갓 접어든 대통령을 향해 독설을 퍼붓는 진짜 이유에 대해 “친명이 주도하는 대통령 사건 공소취소 움직임에 대한 경고”라고 입을 모았다. 유씨로 대변되는 여권 전통 지지층의 절대적 목표는 정권 재창출인데, 대통령 재판을 없애는 공소취소가 현실화될 경우 차기 총선은 물론 대선도 필패한다고 본다는 얘기다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok on 'Shincheonji Offensive': "Linking to a Specific Candidate Is Not My Responsibility" (‘신천지 공세’ 김민석 “특정 후보 연결은 내 책임 아냐”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok on 'Shincheonji Offensive': "Linking to a Specific Candidate Is Not My Responsibility" (‘신천지 공세’ 김민석 “특정 후보 연결은 내 책임 아냐”)

The Democratic Party of Korea is in turmoil over allegations of 'Shincheonji election interference' ahead of its August 17th party convention. Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, a candidate in the party leadership election, first raised the issue, but former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae countered, "If you use my name to suggest involvement, I will take the strongest legal action immediately. Present the exact evidence based on the five Ws and one H." <<> Former Prime Minister Kim posted on X (formerly Twitter) on the 22nd, writing, "I will overcome all of it—anti-Moonism, factionalism, Shincheonji, and their collusion," once again referencing Shincheonji. He is claiming that Shincheonji forces are interfering in the party convention. However, he did not specify whom they support or how they are intervening, only stating, "I will reveal the evidence soon." Pro-Moon YouTubers have been alleging "former Representative Jeong's involvement." Meanwhile, Shincheonji posted a statement on its website the same day, saying, "We have no interest in the Democratic Party convention and have not engaged in any interference." <<> In response, former Prime Minister Kim told reporters, "Hasn't Shincheonji previously claimed to do things?" Regarding the evidence of Shincheonji's interference, he said, "Leave it to me." As for claims linking Shincheonji to former Representative Jeong, he said, "I only pointed out the problem of Shincheonji's political interference. I don't think I need to be responsible for connecting it to a specific candidate." However, the previous day, Kim had argued that Jeong, during his tenure as party leader earlier this year, did not include Shincheonji in the scope of the Unification Church special counsel investigation. Pro-Moon lawmaker Lee Geon-tae, a candidate in the Supreme Council election, also posted on Facebook the same day, saying, "We will establish and operate a 'Shincheonji convention interference (mass party membership) report center' and file an immediate complaint if any illegalities are found." <<> Pro-Moon lawmaker Song Young-gil, a candidate in the party leadership election, also argued during a debate with YouTubers the previous day that the 'one-vote system for delegates and dues-paying members' introduced by Jeong was vulnerable to Shincheonji infiltration. He said, "You can just join the party and pay 1,000 won a month for six months to become a dues-paying member. If Shincheonji gets involved in the Democratic Party leadership election or the next presidential primary, what measures can block them?" <<> Former Representative Jeong appeared on YouTube to deny Shincheonji involvement, stating, "I will punish them most severely. They will definitely pay the price." He also addressed former Prime Minister Kim, saying, "Either quickly provide the evidence, or if you suspect my involvement, report me to the police. Then I will countersue," adding, "This is a matter that should prompt all party members to rise up." <<> Pro-Jeong lawmakers attacked former Prime Minister Kim, demanding, "Provide the evidence." Pro-Jeong Supreme Council candidates Lee Seong-yoon, Choi Min-hee, and Han Min-soo held a press conference and said, "If he cannot provide evidence, he should withdraw from the party leadership race." <<> The party leadership candidates also engaged in a power struggle over a suitability poll released the same day. According to a survey conducted on August 20-21 by pollster KSOI of 1,000 adults nationwide, former Representative Jeong received 25.7% and former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok 21.5%, a shift from results two weeks prior. In Gwangju and Jeolla, Jeong scored 34.0% and Kim 23.1%. Jeong said, "I've reversed the trend by leading significantly in Honam," calling it "the public's expression of 'you're not it.'" However, Kim's camp countered, "In the party leadership election, the vote of party members is key." Among Democratic supporters, Kim led with 36.1% compared to Jeong's 32.6%. (For details, refer to the Central Election Poll Review Committee website.) (더불어민주당이 8·17 전당대회를 앞두고 ‘신천지 선거 개입설’로 시끄럽다. 당대표 선거에 출마한 김민석 전 국무총리가 처음 제기했는데 정청래 전 대표는 “만약 제 이름을 대고 연루설을 제기하는 순간 가장 강력한 방법으로 법적 조치하겠다”며 “육하원칙에 의해 정확하게 근거를 대라”고 했다.)

item.title: PPP Young Turks Propose Abolishing Party Leader, Citing "Imperial System Side Effects" (당대표 폐지론 꺼낸 국힘 소장파 “제왕적 체제 부작용 커”)
item.description:
PPP Young Turks Propose Abolishing Party Leader, Citing "Imperial System Side Effects" (당대표 폐지론 꺼낸 국힘 소장파 “제왕적 체제 부작용 커”)

Within the People Power Party (PPP), arguments are being raised in succession to abolish the party leader system or drastically reduce its powers. The claim is that the operational structure concentrating power in the party leader needs innovation. As non-mainstream members calling for representative Jang Dong-hyuk's resignation have begun open discussions, talk has also emerged from parts of the former pro-Yoon faction saying, "There's no suitable figure to lead an election victory, so the system must be changed." (국민의힘에서 당대표제를 폐지하거나 권한을 대폭 축소하자는 주장이 잇따라 제기되고 있다. 당대표에게 권한이 집중돼 있는 운영 구조를 혁신하자는 주장이다. 장동혁 대표 퇴진을 요구해온 비주류가 공개적으로 논의를 시작한 가운데, 옛 친윤계 일각에서도 “총선 승리를 이끌 인물이 마땅치 않으니 제도를 바꿔야 한다”는 이야기가 나온다.)

On the 22nd, 'Alternatives and Future', a gathering primarily of PPP first and second-term lawmakers, held a breakfast meeting at the National Assembly to discuss ways to improve the "imperial party leader system." Lawmaker Choi Hyung-du, serving as the presenter, explained that the current party leader system concentrates authority, including the power of candidate nomination, on the leader, causing excessive factional conflict. Lee Seong-kwon, the meeting's secretary, stated, "It's true that concentrating authority over party operations, personnel, and nominations on the party leader has many side effects. There were also critical views raised (at the meeting) regarding the party membership structure composed of some hardline supporters." <<> Previously within the PPP, lawmakers like Choi Hyung-du had argued for adopting a U.S.-style party system centered on the floor leader, but this failed to gain traction. However, following the June local elections, calls for abolishing the party leader system intensified both inside and outside the party. At a seminar on July 24th for the 'Future Innovation Forum', a lawmaker research group led by the former pro-Yoon faction, Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon questioned, "Is a party leader truly necessary?" adding, "The party leader's involvement in every social phenomenon has normalized political strife." On the 21st, five-term lawmaker Yoon Sang-hyun, after meeting with Mayor Oh, mentioned abolishing the party leader system and introducing a national primary system. <<> PPP lawmakers say the attention on abolishing the party leader system is not unrelated to dissatisfaction with Representative Jang Dong-hyuk's party management. Right after the local elections, 'Alternatives and Future', the pro-Han faction, and some senior lawmakers publicly demanded Jang's resignation, but Jang did not accept. A pro-Han lawmaker commented, "Representative Jang has proven that once someone becomes party leader, they can hold on no matter how much resignation pressure erupts. The sentiment that the system itself must change has grown." <<> Such concerns are also detectable within the former pro-Yoon faction that supported Representative Jang at last year's national convention. A former pro-Yoon lawmaker explained, "There's a consensus that winning the 2028 general election is difficult under Representative Jang Dong-hyuk's leadership, but there's no suitable card to immediately replace him. So, proposals are emerging from the perspective of 'how about changing the system instead of finding a person.' There's also much deliberation among lawmakers over various alternatives." Within this group, some argue the system should be revised not only regarding Jang but also to prepare for a scenario where independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon rejoins the party and takes the leadership. <<> If abolishing the party leader system is difficult, there are also opinions that a collective leadership system should be introduced to limit the party leader's authority. Six-term lawmaker Joo Ho-young said in a media interview last month, "Isn't it time for a collective leadership system?" A party official stated, "To win the general election, it's necessary to have both the former pro-Yoon and pro-Han factions compete within a collective leadership system." Lawmaker Choi Hyung-du suggested, "One option is to establish a permanent decision-making body where chairpersons of all provincial and city party branches participate ex-officio, involving the party leader as well, to better reflect public sentiment." <<> However, among mainstream lawmakers from the Yeongnam region, there is a sense that further discussion is needed on abolishing the party leader system or transitioning to a collective leadership. A senior lawmaker noted, "There is consensus that we need to revise the rules for electing the party leader, which strongly reflect the voices of hardline party members, before the next national convention to win the general election. But the momentum to enact a change as drastic as abolishing the party leader system is still lacking." <<> The pro-leadership faction tends to dismiss the possibility of abolishing the party leader system, evaluating the calls for abolition as an attempt to bring down Representative Jang. Supreme Council member Kim Jae-won said on YTN Radio today regarding the abolition theory, "It was already argued during the Park Geun-hye emergency committee in 2012, but it wasn't accepted for various reasons. It's impossible without completely abolishing the central party nomination system and switching to a national primary. It has no feasibility." There are also opinions that the positive functions of the party leader system cannot be ignored. An non-lawmaker figure stated, "If the party becomes too focused on the legislature, it could degenerate into an organization that solely represents incumbent lawmakers' interests." (국민의힘 초·재선 의원 중심 모임인 ‘대안과 미래’는 22일 국회에서 조찬 모임을 열고 ‘제왕적 당대표 체제’ 개선 방안을 논의했다. 최형두 의원이 발제자로 나서 현행 당대표제는 대표에게 공천권 등 권한이 집중돼 과도한 계파 갈등을 유발한다고 설명했다. 모임 간사인 이성권 의원은 “당 운영과 인사 및 공천에 관한 권한이 당대표에게 집중되면서 부작용이 많은 것이 사실”이라며 “일부 강성 지지층으로 구성된 당원 구조에 대한 문제 의식도 (모임에서) 나왔다”고 했다.)
